observations: Photo 0: A black console with two controllers (one black, one white) and two PS4 game cases (FC24 and UFC 4) on top. The console has a matte finish with visible scratches and scuffs on the top surface. The PS4 logo is visible on the front left corner.

Photo 1: Same setup from a slightly different angle. The white controller has a distinct design with a white body and black grips, resembling a PS5 DualSense controller, not a PS4 DualShock. The console shows more scratches and wear on the top surface.

Photo 2: Another angle showing the same items. The white controller is clearly visible with its unique shape and button layout, inconsistent with PS4 controllers. The console’s front edge is visible, showing no visible model label or branding other than the PS4 logo.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI KOLA ADEMOLA'.

claims.evidence: No photo shows the console powered on or any internal components. The console’s model (Pro vs standard) cannot be confirmed from the exterior. The white controller is not a PS4 controller, suggesting possible misrepresentation.

risks.risk: The console may not be a PS4 Pro; it could be a standard PS4 or even a non-functional unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console’s front or side showing the model label (e.g., 'PS4 Pro' or 'CUH-72xx') or a video of it powering on and displaying the PS4 home screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard PS4 or non-Pro model, which is less valuable

risks.risk: The white controller is not a PS4 DualShock; it appears to be a PS5 DualSense, which is incompatible with PS4 Pro and may be included to mislead.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the white controller’s front showing the touchpad and button layout, or a video of it connecting to the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if the controller is non-functional or incompatible, reducing value

risks.risk: The console may be damaged internally or have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, power supply) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video of the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, since functionality is unverified

A video of the console powering on and displaying the PS4 home screen.
A close-up photo of the white controller showing its design and buttons to confirm compatibility.
A video of the console playing a game from the included discs.
